raw.question: Mark all non-static dashboard routes as Edge runtime
raw.chosen: Mark all non-static dashboard routes as Edge runtime
raw.reasoning: Cloudflare next-on-pages requires App Router dynamic routes to export runtime=edge; this unblocks Pages build conversion for observer previews.

retrospective.summary: Added runtime=edge exports to dashboard catch-all page and all API routes required by next-on-pages so observer preview build can target Cloudflare Pages.
